name: vital-expert
description: Vital.Expert plugins for Cowork. Digital Health: five merged packs (regulatory and quality, access and value, clinical development, go-to-market, patient and user experience), plus vital-trusted, vital-verify, and navigator-ai-investment, and vital-mlr-review, and vital-decision-companion.

plugins.name: vital-trusted
plugins.description: Nineteen foundational skills for daily life-sciences work on any AI host. Checks against TRUSTED. Prove skills use the VITAL Verify connector (mcp.vital.expert/api/mcp/verify) when a vvfy_ key is present.

plugins.name: vital-verify
plugins.description: Seven skills that check a draft against the pages and papers you supply. Tools run on the VITAL Verify connector.

plugins.name: vital-mlr-review
plugins.description: Multi-jurisdiction Medical–Legal–Regulatory board preparation. Host writes Medical, Legal, and Regulatory chairs; never approves. Tools on mcp.vital.expert/api/mcp/mlr-review (vmlr_). Claim checks stay on Verify.

plugins.name: vital-decision-companion
plugins.description: Leadership decision coaching on its own connector. Scores stay on Ontology Navigator and claim checks stay on Verify. Tools on mcp.vital.expert/api/mcp/decision-companion (vdec_).

plugins.name: navigator-ai-investment
plugins.description: Facilitated AI investment decisions on the VITAL Ontology Navigator. Tools run on the Ontology Navigator connector (vont_ key).
